title: Safety database status — 9 October 2026
summary: No major public-source changes were found that affect the freshness or availability of the safety information currently available in Device Safety Intelligence. Routine source checks completed successfully across the available databases.
updates: FDA announced ongoing electronic reporting code updates for submitters, with an implementation deadline of 31 March 2027; this does not change the public safety-data searches available in the app.
Swissmedic released swissdamed account and registration updates on 1 October 2026. The public field-safety publication search continues to operate normally.
no_major_changes: FDA MAUDE, FDA recalls, FDA Safety Communications, BfArM, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada, PMDA, AEMPS, ANSM, NMPA English, and Swissmedic had no meaningful public setup or access change affecting normal use.
